study_identification_part.si_4_title: Using normative models pre-trained on cross-sectional data to evaluate intra-individual longitudinal changes in neuroimaging data

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Pre-trained lifespan_58K_82_sites normative model; local Early Stages of Schizophrenia longitudinal cohort with patients and controls.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "The clinical data used for the analysis were part of the Early Stages of Schizophrenia study" ... "The pre-trained model used for adaptation was the lifespan_58K_82_sites"

answer.None (Pre-Trained NM): Pre-trained normative model (lifespan_58K_82_sites) adapted for longitudinal analysis.

answer.Early Stages of Schizophrenia: Longitudinal clinical cohort (98 patients, 67 controls); controls used for site-specific adaptation and held-out variance estimation; patients used for longitudinal evaluation.

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Pre-trained model provides the normative baseline; local controls support adaptation/variance estimation while patient data provide longitudinal evaluation.
